# Professional Profile {icon="circle-user" before=25.7 after=15 iw=11.9 h=11.9}

Transportation data scientist with 3+ years of specialized experience in travel demand forecasting, spatial econometrics, and economic impact assessment. Proven expertise in developing stochastic models for regional transportation systems, conducting predictive analysis on multi-modal datasets, and translating complex technical analyses into strategic insights for infrastructure investment decisions. Strong foundation in computational methods, geospatial statistics, and stakeholder engagement across metropolitan planning organizations and state transportation agencies.

# Professional Experience {icon="briefcase" before=26.3 after=18.1 h=13.9}

## Wasatch Front Regional Council {.entry place="Salt Lake City, UT" role="Data Scientist II – Full Time" dates="September 2025 – Present" before=0 pitch=13.7 gap=14.2}

- Lead development and calibration of four-step and activity-based travel demand models for Utah’s six-county Wasatch Front region (population 2.7M+), utilizing **Cube Voyager**, **R**, and **Python**, generating 30-year forecasts to inform \$15+ billion in regional infrastructure investment decisions.
- Develop automated geospatial analysis workflows to support Regional Transportation Plan (RTP) and Wasatch Choice Vision initiatives, translating complex transportation systems analysis into actionable insights for local governments, transportation agencies, and regional stakeholders through interactive **R-Shiny** dashboards and **ArcGIS Experience Builder** applications.

## Metro Analytics {.entry place="Atlanta, GA" role="Transportation Planner/Analyst – Full Time" dates="June 2023 – September 2025" pitch=13.7 gap=14.2}

- Developed and calibrated four-step travel demand models using **TransCAD** for multiple MPOs across the Southeast (Bowling Green-Warren County KY and Lower Savannah COG SC), generating 25-year travel forecasts and evaluating alternative scenarios to support long-range investment decisions for regions serving population exceeding 200,000.
- Led scenario-based economic impact assessment for multi-billion dollar infrastructure investments (Utah’s Unified Transportation Plan 2023-2050, Utah Transit Authority, Des Moines Area MPO) using integrated travel demand (**Cube Voyager**), land use (**REMM**), and economic modeling platforms (**IMPLAN**, **TREDIS**), quantifying economic effects and employment impacts.
- Conducted comprehensive benefit-cost analyses for major infrastructure projects valued at \$12+ billion including Ohio DOT Cleveland intersection improvements and Missouri DOT STIP programs, applying USDOT guidance and economic evaluation methodologies.
- Built automated geospatial analysis workflows in **R** and **Python** processing large-scale Census, LEHD/LODES, and CTPP datasets to generate socio-economic inputs for regional travel demand models across Georgia, South Carolina, and Kentucky.
- Integrated diverse transportation datasets (HPMS, NBI, AASHTOWare Crash Data) to develop data-driven project prioritization frameworks for regional freight plans and long-range plans.
- Developed spatial databases (**ESRI AGOL**, **SQLite**) supporting multi-state and national research programs (NCHRP 08-146 Transportation Resiliency, BTS Cybersecurity Research); created interactive dashboards using **R-Shiny**, **ArcGIS Experience Builder**, and **WordPress**.
